equity_transfer: Mathematics may be shared; these UTC state/turnover thresholds and perpetual funding assumptions do not validate stock accounts.

cards.economic_mechanism: Price persistence and slow information adjustment
cards.known_inputs: Prior closed EWMAC32/128, robust35day volatility and existing training normalization; contemporaneously eligible names
cards.off_domain: request flat at the next declared rebalance, retain actual inventory until exits fill
cards.failure_conditions: Whipsaw, abrupt reversal, fees, co-moving asset concentration; no demand to profit in range markets
cards.falsifier: No positive net expectancy in the registered trend domain after both costs, or tail/risk budget breached
cards.baseline: Frozen full-domain trend account; exposure and opportunity differences disclosed

cards.economic_mechanism: Cross-sectional persistence, not only the direction of BTC
cards.known_inputs: Existing21day ranks, at least10liquid names, long top5/short bottom5; no new ranking formula
cards.off_domain: cash in volatility expansion, liquidity stress or unknown state
cards.failure_conditions: Rank reversal, common-factor crowding, short funding and asymmetric fills
cards.falsifier: Conditional relative ranks have no cost-resilient complete-campaign advantage
cards.baseline: Frozen full-domain relative momentum and cash; keep long/short net exposure explicit

cards.economic_mechanism: Observed funding compensation combined with21day momentum; not pure risk-free carry
cards.known_inputs: Existing momentum plus inverse5complete-day settled funding rank; unknown rates keep intent absent
cards.off_domain: cash outside the registered low-trend state
cards.failure_conditions: Negative carry reversal, crowded hedge unwinds, basis risk, directional contamination
cards.falsifier: Both-cost net advantage absent; report funding and price PnL separately and compare momentum-only ablation
cards.baseline: Frozen full-domain carry_momentum, relative_momentum ablation and cash; no claim all returns are funding alpha

cards.economic_mechanism: Extreme short-term displacement reverses when broad trend is weak
cards.known_inputs: Unchanged mr_wings4 public formula and3sigma boundary; no relaxation to manufacture trades
cards.failure_conditions: Individual assets may trend despite BTC range; gap/fee losses and sparse samples
cards.falsifier: No cost-resilient expectancy or sufficient complete lifecycles in the predeclared domain
cards.baseline: Frozen full-domain mean reversion and cash; a zero-trade result is insufficient evidence, not proof of inefficiency

cards.economic_mechanism: Range escape may persist during observable volatility expansion
cards.known_inputs: Existing10day midpoint breakout EWM2 plus prior-day volatility classification
cards.failure_conditions: False breakouts, spread widening, stops and costly exits
cards.falsifier: After-cost breakout expectancy absent or decline in executable capacity during expansion
cards.baseline: Frozen full-domain breakout and cash; no future volatility labels

cards.economic_mechanism: Training-only stationary relative-price residual; distinct from outright asset reversion
cards.known_inputs: Original both-direction cointegration/FDR/Johansen and cost gate; range restriction is a new exploratory hypothesis, not a relabelling of existing26accounts
cards.off_domain: new version must close old paired inventory with ownership retained until both legs flat
cards.failure_conditions: Relationship break, model changes, unequal fills, funding and idle capacity
cards.falsifier: No cost-resilient pair expectancy, inadequate matched cycles or intended-sleeve fill capacity
cards.baseline: Original fixed/rolling formation accounts; do not loosen tests or rank by later pair profit

cards.economic_mechanism: Reduce loss exposure after covered official releases; not an independent alpha claim
cards.known_inputs: Verified actual FOMC release+5min and next24h; no announcement anticipation or other-news completeness claim
cards.off_domain: risk reduction can act across enabled modules; unknown news is not no news
cards.failure_conditions: Lost upside, execution delay and unobserved shocks
cards.falsifier: No same-opportunity total-account drawdown benefit after return sacrifice and switch costs
